create_tolerance_reward: create a reward function using tolerance() to return 1 inside bounds and sigmoidally decay outside
test_tolerance_gaussian: test tolerance() with gaussian sigmoid and margin to compute smooth reward values
test_tolerance_linear: test tolerance() with linear sigmoid for piecewise linear reward decay outside bounds
test_tolerance_quadratic: test tolerance() with quadratic sigmoid for smooth parabolic reward decay
test_tolerance_bounds: test tolerance() with exact bounds (0.0, 0.0) to reward values at a target point
